decisions.reason: The reusable citrus crate builds directly on the firm's core injection-moulding and crate know-how, but it serves a narrow agricultural niche with only modest website visibility, so there is some risk it is dropped.
The foldable large container kept a page of its own in both years, which signals sustained commitment, and it rests on established container design knowledge that the firm can readily improve.
Stackable plastic crates are the firm's core competence, so absorptive capacity is high and the product fits the established line.
The medium-duty rackable pallet sits squarely within the firm's pallet expertise, and the firm can interpret early results and refine the design.

The spill-retention pallet draws on adjacent knowledge such as hazardous-goods regulation, and its drop from a dedicated page to a mention in 2019 suggests reduced emphasis, but it still fits the pallet portfolio.
The pallet with load retainers is a variant of the core pallet line, but its downgrade from a dedicated page to a mention suggests weaker priority; related know-how still supports keeping it.
